title: Identification of highly specific bacterial L-asparaginase through genome-wide computational screening and experimental validation.
authors: Janicki, Maciej; Zielezinski, Andrzej; Pierog, Izabela; Sliwiak, Joanna; Ludwikow, Agnieszka; Karlowski, Wojciech M; Jaskolski, Mariusz; Loch, Joanna I
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过AlphaFold2结构预测、分子对接和MD模拟对细菌L-天冬酰胺酶进行全基因组筛选，并实验验证了高特异性候选酶，属于蛋白质结构计算与实验结合的应用，但方法创新性有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Bacterial L-asparaginases are key therapeutics for acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL), but their clinical efficacy is limited by off-target L-glutaminase co-activity, which contributes to severe side effects. This study aimed to identify highly specific bacterial L-asparaginases with minimal L-glutaminase co-activity. METHODS: We screened ~ 85,000 prokaryotic genomes using a workflow integrating AlphaFold2 structure prediction, molecular docking, binding-energy estimation, and molecular dynamics simulations. Six top-ranked enzymes were selected for experimental validation. RESULTS: RhAII protein from Acidobacteriota sp. showed high specificity toward L-asparagine (L-Asn), with a Michaelis constant (K(M)) of 12 +/- 2 microM and turnover number (k(cat)) of 34 +/- 2 s(-)(1), and negligible L-glutaminase activity. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations revealed a relationship between enzyme activity and the conformational dynamics of the flexible gating element (FGE), characterized by residue-level root mean square fluctuation (RMSF), and L-Asn positional fluctuations, evaluated by ligand root mean square deviation (RMSD) relative to the protein. High L-asparaginase activity was associated with optimal FGE dynamics and low L-Asn RMSD, consistent with stable substrate positioning within the active site. In contrast, enzymes with altered FGE dynamics relative to the reference EcAII enzyme from Escherichia coli, such as PoAII from Planctomycetota sp., showed poor L-asparaginase performance (K(M) 5797 +/- 1143 microM; k(cat) 1.2 +/- 0.1 s(-)(1)). CONCLUSIONS: Genome- and structure-guided screening identified RhAII as a promising antileukemic candidate for further validation in biological models. A key limitation of the computational workflow was the lack of correlation between predicted substrate binding energies and catalytic efficiency, highlighting the importance of active-site dynamics in enzyme kinetics.
abstract_zh: 背景：细菌L-天冬酰胺酶是急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）的关键治疗药物，但其临床疗效受限于脱靶的L-谷氨酰胺酶共活性，这会导致严重的不良反应。本研究旨在鉴定具有最小L-谷氨酰胺酶共活性的高特异性细菌L-天冬酰胺酶。方法：我们利用整合了AlphaFold2结构预测、分子对接、结合能估算和分子动力学模拟的工作流程，筛选了约85,000个原核生物基因组。选取了六个排名靠前的酶进行实验验证。结果：来自酸杆菌门（Acidobacteriota sp.）的RhAII蛋白对L-天冬酰胺（L-Asn）表现出高特异性，其米氏常数（K(M)）为12 ± 2微摩尔，转换数（k(cat)）为34 ± 2 s⁻¹，且L-谷氨酰胺酶活性可忽略不计。分子动力学（MD）模拟揭示了酶活性与柔性门控元件（FGE）构象动力学之间的关系，该关系通过残基水平的均方根波动（RMSF）表征，以及L-Asn位置波动（通过配体相对于蛋白质的均方根偏差（RMSD）评估）之间的关系。高L-天冬酰胺酶活性与最优的FGE动力学和低L-Asn RMSD相关，这与底物在活性位点内的稳定定位一致。相比之下，相对于来自大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）的参考酶EcAII，FGE动力学发生改变的酶（如来自浮霉菌门（Planctomycetota sp.）的PoAII）表现出较差的L-天冬酰胺酶性能（K(M) 5797 ± 1143微摩尔；k(cat) 1.2 ± 0.1 s⁻¹）。结论：基于基因组和结构的筛选鉴定出RhAII是一个有前景的抗白血病候选药物，可用于进一步的生物学模型验证。该计算工作流程的一个关键局限性在于预测的底物结合能与催化效率之间缺乏相关性，这凸显了活性位点动力学在酶动力学中的重要性。
